about: Fixed evaluation set for the visual engine. Every change to the planner, validator or renderer is scored against it (checklist 0.4). 'mustShow' lists what a correct lesson visibly does.

rubric.correctness: Facts, values and steps are right (checked against tools where possible). 0–5
rubric.visualMatch: Each beat's board shows what its narration says. 0–5
rubric.clarity: Nothing overlaps, clips or goes off-screen; text is readable; the focus is obvious. 0–5
rubric.motion: Changes are animated as transitions (swap, move, morph, trace), not cuts; pacing is calm. 0–5
rubric.pedagogy: Beats build from simple to complete; titles are useful; ends with the answer. 0–5
rubric.validity: Scene passes validateScene without repair (5), after one repair (3), after two (1), never (0).
rubric.latencySeconds: Time to first beat on screen (recorded, not scored).
